trigger: Synthetic attack showed that generic DOJ investigation language could be misclassified as antitrust enforcement.
amendment: ANTITRUST_ENFORCEMENT_SINGLE_NAME now requires explicit title+slug language containing antitrust, competition authority, competition regulator, or monopoly in addition to an enforcement action. DOJ/FTC identity alone cannot establish antitrust semantics.
precision_direction: Stricter; may increase false negatives. This is intentional and cannot be relaxed after real v2 counts are observed without a new protocol version.
